title: Digital Overload Confession
description: A surreal painting depicts a magenta silhouetted figure pointing and shouting at a lime green person with a smartphone for a head, who sits at a desk covered in sticky notes. The background features a large swirling vortex of distorted text, dollar signs, clock faces, and fragmented words like ONE, ID, EL, and social media icons.
prompt: Surreal painting of a magenta silhouette figure aggressively pointing and speaking to a lime green humanoid with a glowing smartphone instead of a head, sitting behind a desk covered in sticky notes. The figure has a speech bubble saying 'I WANT TO KNOW WHO YOUR MANAGER IS BECAUSE EVERY TIME I CALL THIS JOINT'. Behind them is a massive swirling colorful vortex made of distorted text, clock faces, dollar signs, and words like ONE, ID, EL, social media icons and notifications in a chaotic spiral, vibrant contrasting colors, painterly style
